'''Eric Deluca HIdden Base - X-Wings v 2 0''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Eric Deluca]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-12889">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12889 HIdden Base - X-Wings v 2 0], DeckTech (Eric "punkrockert8" Deluca, 14 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12889/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12889/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018102922/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12889/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''HIdden Base - X-Wings v 2 0'''
* '''Author:''' Eric "punkrockert8" Deluca
* '''Published:''' January 14, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is like my old x-wing deck, but it has some modifications so that it works better.

=== Strategy ===

The Strategy is simple, deploy systems, stop force drains with cards u have, flip, drain for alot, beat up people in space, stop drains. Against search and destroy i have honor, that should help me for a while, and also helps me against scum. thats the deck, more details about how to play are in the other version.
